idea-plugin.name: Artemis String Normalizer
idea-plugin.description:
Artemis String Normalizer

This plugin is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Artemis or TUM.

A postfix template tool that converts Artemis-encoded strings into clean, readable Java code.

Features

  • Replaces the special symbol ⎵ with a real space
  • Converts variables inside <...> into Java identifiers
  • Ignores invalid placeholders (e.g. with spaces or symbols)
  • Escapes strings safely for Java source code
  • Works in .java files via postfix templates
  • .artemis – converts into Java string expressions using concatenation
  • .artemisf – converts into a complete System.out.printf statement with matching arguments

Examples

String expression: 
"(<X>/<Y>)⎵Enter⎵your⎵guess:".artemis
-->
"(" + X + "/" + Y + ") Enter your guess:"
Printf output: 
"(<X>/<Y>)⎵Enter⎵your⎵guess:".artemisf
-->
System.out.printf("(%s/%s) Enter your guess:", X, Y);
